description: This file contains shape checking functions for im2col and col2im operations in PyTorch's ATen library, including input validation, dimension checks, and size calculations.

methods.name: col2im_shape_check
methods.description: Performs shape validation for the col2im operation, checking tensor dimensions, kernel size, stride, dilation, padding, and expected input size.

methods.name: im2col_shape_check
methods.description: Performs shape validation for the im2col operation, checking tensor dimensions, kernel size, stride, dilation, padding, and output size calculations.
